data.title: bn-7za: Add bounded screen text diagnostics
data.description: Review strict crop and summary contracts across CLI/RPC/playtests, output bounds, metadata semantics, full-frame compatibility, eval-phase coexistence, docs, and regressions.

data.body: INFO: Solid, strict contract with excellent coverage across CLI/RPC/playtest. Verified: validate() guards zero/overflow/out-of-range via checked_add; framebuffer indexing stays within [0,FB_LEN) post-validation; the crop budget (16384) is enforced identically in oneshot parse, playtest validate_scenario, and session screen_text_report, with full-frame correctly exempted; summary output is bounded regardless of region size (palette/glyph counts capped at 64 keys). Backwards-compatible: legacy screen_text stays byte-identical since color_char already applies & COLOR_MASK, so the added mask at session.rs:536 only affects the new palette_counts/background detection. cargo clippy clean; focused screen_text/dispatch/playtest/session suites all green.

data.reason: Strict, well-tested bounded screen-text contract; clippy clean, all focused suites pass, backwards-compatible.
Accepted as verification evidence; no source change requested.
